characters.name: Vincent Spaulding
characters.note: Pawnbroker's assistant; in fact John Clay's accomplice, not a red-head.

characters.name: Duncan Ross
characters.note: Red-headed agent of the League; a false identity used by the conspirators.

characters.name: John Clay
characters.note: Criminal mastermind and grandson of a royal duke; leads the cellar tunnel plot.

characters.name: Archie
characters.note: Red-haired accomplice who dives down the hole.

characters.name: Peter Jones
characters.note: Official police agent from Scotland Yard.

characters.name: Mr. Merryweather
characters.note: Chairman of directors of the City and Suburban Bank.

characters.name: Ezekiah Hopkins
characters.note: Deceased benefactor named in the advertisement; mentioned only.

characters.name: Miss Mary Sutherland
characters.note: Client of an earlier case; mentioned only.

characters.name: Sarasate
characters.note: Violinist performing at St. James's Hall; mentioned only.

brief.era: London, 1890; autumn 1890 with the story's events in October.
brief.place: Central London: the shabby Saxe-Coburg Square near the City, crowded Fleet Street and Pope's Court, the busy City thoroughfare, and a bank cellar with stone flags and crates.
brief.dress: Victorian: frock-coats, top-hats, greatcoats, pea-jacket, Albert chain; Wilson in baggy grey shepherd's check trousers and a drab waistcoat; Holmes in a dressing gown and pipe at home.
brief.buildings_and_objects: Brick two-storey houses, gas-lit streets, hansom cabs, pawnbroker's three gilt balls and brown board, the League's office with a cardboard notice, a cellar of crates and lead-foil-packed napoleons, a dark lantern, hunting crop, revolver, and handcuffs.
depiction_rules: Red hair is the defining trait of the League's men; depict it vividly red where it is described.
Spaulding should show a white acid splash on the forehead and pierced ears for earrings.
Holmes's knees and the worn trouser knees are a clue; render them with some wear and staining.
Keep the bank cellar dark and lit only by the lantern in the climactic scenes.
